inner_groups: 3 grouped OOF assessments per outer-training pool; each branch uses disjoint task T60/V20/C20; final outer branch uses same partition policy

metrics.prevalence_reference: constant-probability AP equals test class prevalence within a fold; also save a genuine T-only prevalence predictor and its pooled metrics, which can differ from the global constant-score baseline

metrics.multiplicity: multiple comparisons remain exploratory; no unadjusted interval establishes universal superiority

visual.representation: CNN spatial means128+256+512=896; equal mean across16 timestamps and3 views
visual.head: original896->128 ReLU dropout0.1 ->1; new target head for each fit
visual.V1: original pretrained frozen CNN; new head100 epochs

visual.retention: best selected checkpoint, full final100 recovery checkpoint, every epoch history; final/recovery hardlink shares immutable bytes

sensors.channels: 14 position fields,12 nonplaceholder velocities,2 gripper-effort fields; not force/torque
sensors.statistics: exact original10stat/channel routine,280 stat-major features; no target/source/task/action metadata inputs

fusion.F1: unweighted mean of calibrated branch probabilities
fusion.F2: source-exact unweighted C1 logistic on [visual_probability,S3_probability]; new coefficients per condition/outer/seed; fit grouped OOF only
fusion.quality_gate: source DecisionGate(F5) quality-only plus availability,13inputs hidden16 ReLU2softmax weighted branch logits;40fixed epochs AdamW1e-3 wd1e-3; fit OOF only
fusion.quality_context: 6 image-quality fields measured on selected inputs +5 sensor-quality fields +2 availability flags; OOF-only normalization; no task/action identity
fusion.gate_selection: fixed architecture and budget, no meta selection on outer test
fusion.quality_attribution_control: same DecisionGate architecture, seed, OOF inputs and40epoch budget, but all quality fields held at zero during fitting/inference; learned static logit mixture with availability masking
fusion.corruption_training: clean-trained F2 and gate; no special augmentation advantage; learned reliability assessed only when both branches present
fusion.matched_augmented_controls: separately fit F2_aug, Gate_aug and availability-only Gate_static_aug on cleanOOF plus exactly1label-blind corruptedOOF record per native episode; corruption chosen by episode hash from blur5,occlusion0.25,missing_channels0.25,noise0.5,combined_partial; original inner-held-out branch checkpoint/calibrator generates each record; noise scale uses its own T only;20gate epochs on2N records matches40epochs onNclean presentations; no CNN/sensor retraining; repeated augmented rows are not independent examples
fusion.complete_missing: same explicit surviving-branch fallback for averaging/F2/gate; absent unimodal gets T prevalence reference; both absent abstain

robustness: fixed label-blind scenarios and intensities in src/vifailback/corruptions.py; T-only observed channel std for noise; edge-padded within-episode shifts are sampling perturbations, not physical clock calibration; clean replay must agree with saved main probabilities within0.001 absolute, without consulting labels; otherwise stop affected stress stage for numerical investigation
